questions.cardText:
[Archaeology] The Egyptian pyramids were most likely built by:
A. Slaves
B. Paid laborers
C. Greeks
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wer hat laut den bei Gizeh gefundenen Arbeitergräbern die ägyptischen Pyramiden höchstwahrscheinlich gebaut – und nicht Sklaven, wie lange angenommen?
questions.en: According to the workers' tombs found beside them at Giza, who most likely built the Egyptian pyramids – rather than slaves, as was long believed?

timeline.labelEn: Tombs of the pyramid builders are discovered beside the pyramids at Giza
timeline.labelDe: Die Gräber der Pyramidenarbeiter werden neben den Pyramiden von Gizeh entdeckt

questions.notes: Card correct: the workers' tombs support paid laborers, not slaves; the slave myth goes back to Herodotus.

questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] What is melanin responsible for?
A. Sleep
B. Skin pigmentation
C. Wound healing
Answer: B. Melanin is the natural pigment that gives our hair, skin, and eyes their color. It is also known to provide some protection against the effects of UV radiation. Generally, darker-skinned individuals have melanin that is more spread out in the skin, while lighter-skinned individuals have more clumped melanin.
questions.de: Welches natürliche Pigment verleiht menschlichem Haar, Haut und Augen ihre Farbe und schützt etwas vor UV-Strahlung?
questions.en: Which natural pigment gives human hair, skin and eyes their colour and offers some protection against UV radiation?

timeline.labelEn: Jöns Jacob Berzelius applies the name melanin to a dark pigment from the eye
timeline.labelDe: Jöns Jacob Berzelius belegt ein dunkles Pigment aus dem Auge mit dem Namen Melanin

questions.notes: Card correct. Timeline (Berzelius 1840) from web search, not the source page; Merriam-Webster traces the word to Bartolomeo Bizio (1825), hence approx. Don't confuse with melatonin (sleep).
